name: array_comprehensive_test.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((ArrayStringKeyTest (mk-ArrayStringKeyTest (dict (Array String Int))))))
(declare-datatypes () ((ArrayBoolValueTest (mk-ArrayBoolValueTest (flags (Array Int Bool))))))
(declare-datatypes () ((ArrayComputedIndexTest (mk-ArrayComputedIndexTest (data (Array Int Int))))))
(declare-datatypes () ((ArrayDefaultTest (mk-ArrayDefaultTest (arr (Array Int Int))))))
(declare-datatypes () ((ArrayArithmeticTest (mk-ArrayArithmeticTest (scores (Array Int Int))))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-ArrayStringKeyTest (sel-ArrayStringKeyTest ArrayStringKeyTest))
  (lift-ArrayBoolValueTest (sel-ArrayBoolValueTest ArrayBoolValueTest))
  (lift-ArrayComputedIndexTest (sel-ArrayComputedIndexTest ArrayComputedIndexTest))
  (lift-ArrayDefaultTest (sel-ArrayDefaultTest ArrayDefaultTest))
  (lift-ArrayArithmeticTest (sel-ArrayArithmeticTest ArrayArithmeticTest))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-ArrayStringKeyTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-ArrayStringKeyTest (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-ArrayStringKeyTest ((this Ref)) ArrayStringKeyTest
  (sel-ArrayStringKeyTest (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-ArrayBoolValueTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-ArrayBoolValueTest (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-ArrayBoolValueTest ((this Ref)) ArrayBoolValueTest
  (sel-ArrayBoolValueTest (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-ArrayComputedIndexTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-ArrayComputedIndexTest (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-ArrayComputedIndexTest ((this Ref)) ArrayComputedIndexTest
  (sel-ArrayComputedIndexTest (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-ArrayDefaultTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-ArrayDefaultTest (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-ArrayDefaultTest ((this Ref)) ArrayDefaultTest
  (sel-ArrayDefaultTest (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-ArrayArithmeticTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-ArrayArithmeticTest (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-ArrayArithmeticTest ((this Ref)) ArrayArithmeticTest
  (sel-ArrayArithmeticTest (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-ArrayStringKeyTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-ArrayStringKeyTest this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-ArrayBoolValueTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-ArrayBoolValueTest this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-ArrayComputedIndexTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-ArrayComputedIndexTest this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-ArrayDefaultTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-ArrayDefaultTest this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-ArrayArithmeticTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-ArrayArithmeticTest this)
)

; ================

;   Getters for class ArrayStringKeyTest:
; -----------------------------------------

; --- getters for ArrayStringKeyTest.dict: ---

(define-fun ArrayStringKeyTest!dict ((this Ref)) (Array String Int)

)

(define-fun ArrayBoolValueTest!flags ((this Ref)) (Array Int Bool)

)

)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class ArrayStringKeyTest:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-ArrayStringKeyTest ArrayStringKeyTest)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun ArrayStringKeyTest.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (ArrayStringKeyTest!dict this) "one") 1)
)

(assert (! (ArrayStringKeyTest.inv1 2) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun ArrayStringKeyTest.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (ArrayStringKeyTest!dict this) "two") 2)
)

(assert (! (ArrayStringKeyTest.inv2 2) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun ArrayStringKeyTest.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (ArrayStringKeyTest!dict this) "sum") (+ (select (ArrayStringKeyTest!dict this) "one") (select (ArrayStringKeyTest!dict this) "two")))
)

(assert (! (ArrayStringKeyTest.inv3 2) :named _xkassert2))



; -------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class ArrayBoolValueTest:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-ArrayBoolValueTest ArrayBoolValueTest)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun ArrayBoolValueTest.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (ArrayBoolValueTest!flags this) 0) true)
)

(assert (! (ArrayBoolValueTest.inv1 1) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun ArrayBoolValueTest.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (ArrayBoolValueTest!flags this) 1) false)
)

(assert (! (ArrayBoolValueTest.inv2 1) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun ArrayBoolValueTest.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (ArrayBoolValueTest!flags this) 2) (select (ArrayBoolValueTest!flags this) 0))
)

(assert (! (ArrayBoolValueTest.inv3 1) :named _xkassert5))



; -----------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class ArrayComputedIndexTest:
; -----------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-ArrayComputedIndexTest ArrayComputedIndexTest)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun ArrayComputedIndexTest.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (ArrayComputedIndexTest!data this) 10) 100)
)

(assert (! (ArrayComputedIndexTest.inv1 3) :named _xkassert6))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun ArrayComputedIndexTest.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (ArrayComputedIndexTest!data this) (+ 10 1)) 200)
)

(assert (! (ArrayComputedIndexTest.inv2 3) :named _xkassert7))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun ArrayComputedIndexTest.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (ArrayComputedIndexTest!data this) (+ 10 2)) (+ (select (ArrayComputedIndexTest!data this) 10) (select (ArrayComputedIndexTest!data this) 11)))
)

(assert (! (ArrayComputedIndexTest.inv3 3) :named _xkassert8))



; -----------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class ArrayDefaultTest:
; -----------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-5-ArrayDefaultTest ArrayDefaultTest)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun ArrayDefaultTest.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (ArrayDefaultTest!arr this) 0) 42)
)

(assert (! (ArrayDefaultTest.inv1 5) :named _xkassert9))



; --------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class ArrayArithmeticTest:
; --------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-4-ArrayArithmeticTest ArrayArithmeticTest)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun ArrayArithmeticTest.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (ArrayArithmeticTest!scores this) 0) 85)
)

(assert (! (ArrayArithmeticTest.inv1 4) :named _xkassert10))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun ArrayArithmeticTest.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (ArrayArithmeticTest!scores this) 1) 90)
)

(assert (! (ArrayArithmeticTest.inv2 4) :named _xkassert11))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun ArrayArithmeticTest.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (ArrayArithmeticTest!scores this) 2) 78)
)

(assert (! (ArrayArithmeticTest.inv3 4) :named _xkassert12))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun ArrayArithmeticTest.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (select (ArrayArithmeticTest!scores this) 3) (+ (+ (select (ArrayArithmeticTest!scores this) 0) (select (ArrayArithmeticTest!scores this) 1)) (select (ArrayArithmeticTest!scores this) 2)))
)

(assert (! (ArrayArithmeticTest.inv4 4) :named _xkassert13))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        2 (lift-ArrayStringKeyTest const-2-ArrayStringKeyTest))
        1 (lift-ArrayBoolValueTest const-1-ArrayBoolValueTest))
        3 (lift-ArrayComputedIndexTest const-3-ArrayComputedIndexTest))
        5 (lift-ArrayDefaultTest const-5-ArrayDefaultTest))
        4 (lift-ArrayArithmeticTest const-4-ArrayArithmeticTest))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-ArrayBoolValueTest () ArrayBoolValueTest
  (mk-ArrayBoolValueTest (store ((as const (Array Int Bool)) true) 1 false)))
(define-fun const-3-ArrayComputedIndexTest () ArrayComputedIndexTest
  (let ((a!1 (store (store (store ((as const (Array Int Int)) 5) 13 14) 11 200)
                  12
                  300)))
  (mk-ArrayComputedIndexTest (store a!1 10 100))))
(define-fun const-5-ArrayDefaultTest () ArrayDefaultTest
  (mk-ArrayDefaultTest (store (store ((as const (Array Int Int)) 8) 0 42) 13 15)))
(define-fun const-4-ArrayArithmeticTest () ArrayArithmeticTest
  (let ((a!1 (store (store (store ((as const (Array Int Int)) 9) 1 90) 3 253)
                  0
                  85)))
  (mk-ArrayArithmeticTest (store (store a!1 2 78) 4 6))))
(define-fun const-2-ArrayStringKeyTest () ArrayStringKeyTest
  (mk-ArrayStringKeyTest
  (store (store ((as const (Array String Int)) 2) "sum" 3) "one" 1)))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (dict (sel-ArrayStringKeyTest (select heap 2))) "sum"))
      (a!2 (select (dict (sel-ArrayStringKeyTest (select heap 2))) "one"))
      (a!3 (select (dict (sel-ArrayStringKeyTest (select heap 2))) "two")))
  (= a!1 (+ a!2 a!3))))
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (data (sel-ArrayComputedIndexTest (select heap 3))) (+ 10 1))))
  (= a!1 200)))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (flags (sel-ArrayBoolValueTest (select heap 1))) 2))
      (a!2 (select (flags (sel-ArrayBoolValueTest (select heap 1))) 0)))
  (= a!1 a!2)))
(define-fun _xkassert9 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (arr (sel-ArrayDefaultTest (select heap 5))) 0)))
  (= a!1 42)))
(define-fun _xkassert13 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (scores (sel-ArrayArithmeticTest (select heap 4))) 3))
      (a!2 (select (scores (sel-ArrayArithmeticTest (select heap 4))) 0))
      (a!3 (select (scores (sel-ArrayArithmeticTest (select heap 4))) 1))
      (a!4 (select (scores (sel-ArrayArithmeticTest (select heap 4))) 2)))
  (= a!1 (+ a!2 a!3 a!4))))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (dict (sel-ArrayStringKeyTest (select heap 2))) "one")))
  (= a!1 1)))
(define-fun _xkassert8 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (data (sel-ArrayComputedIndexTest (select heap 3))) (+ 10 2)))
      (a!2 (select (data (sel-ArrayComputedIndexTest (select heap 3))) 10))
      (a!3 (select (data (sel-ArrayComputedIndexTest (select heap 3))) 11)))
  (= a!1 (+ a!2 a!3))))
(define-fun _xkassert10 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (scores (sel-ArrayArithmeticTest (select heap 4))) 0)))
  (= a!1 85)))
(define-fun _xkassert12 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (scores (sel-ArrayArithmeticTest (select heap 4))) 2)))
  (= a!1 78)))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (flags (sel-ArrayBoolValueTest (select heap 1))) 0)))
  (= a!1 true)))
(define-fun _xkassert11 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (scores (sel-ArrayArithmeticTest (select heap 4))) 1)))
  (= a!1 90)))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (data (sel-ArrayComputedIndexTest (select heap 3))) 10)))
  (= a!1 100)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (dict (sel-ArrayStringKeyTest (select heap 2))) "two")))
  (= a!1 2)))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select (flags (sel-ArrayBoolValueTest (select heap 1))) 1)))
  (= a!1 false)))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (mk-ArrayStringKeyTest
             (store (store ((as const (Array String Int)) 2) "sum" 3) "one" 1)))
      (a!2 (lift-ArrayBoolValueTest
             (mk-ArrayBoolValueTest
               (store ((as const (Array Int Bool)) true) 1 false))))
      (a!3 (store (store (store ((as const (Array Int Int)) 5) 13 14) 11 200)
                  12
                  300))
      (a!5 (mk-ArrayDefaultTest
             (store (store ((as const (Array Int Int)) 8) 0 42) 13 15)))
      (a!6 (store (store (store ((as const (Array Int Int)) 9) 1 90) 3 253)
                  0
                  85)))
(let ((a!4 (store (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                                2
                                (lift-ArrayStringKeyTest a!1))
                         1
                         a!2)
                  3
                  (lift-ArrayComputedIndexTest
                    (mk-ArrayComputedIndexTest (store a!3 10 100)))))
      (a!7 (lift-ArrayArithmeticTest
             (mk-ArrayArithmeticTest (store (store a!6 2 78) 4 6)))))
  (store (store a!4 5 (lift-ArrayDefaultTest a!5)) 4 a!7))))
(define-fun k!15 ((x!0 Int)) Int
  (ite (= x!0 0) 42
  (ite (= x!0 13) 15
    8)))
(define-fun k!13 ((x!0 Int)) Int
  (ite (= x!0 13) 14
  (ite (= x!0 11) 200
  (ite (= x!0 12) 300
  (ite (= x!0 10) 100
    5)))))
(define-fun k!14 ((x!0 Int)) Int
  (ite (= x!0 1) 90
  (ite (= x!0 3) 253
  (ite (= x!0 0) 85
  (ite (= x!0 2) 78
  (ite (= x!0 4) 6
    9))))))
